hooks.command: root="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${PLUGIN_ROOT:?CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT or PLUGIN_ROOT must be set}}"; exec "$root/scripts/launch.sh" maintain --startup
hooks.commandWindows: if defined CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT (call "%CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT%\scripts\launch.cmd" maintain --startup) else if defined PLUGIN_ROOT (call "%PLUGIN_ROOT%\scripts\launch.cmd" maintain --startup) else (echo CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT or PLUGIN_ROOT must be set 1>&2 & exit /b 2)
